top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a distinct, mature discovery: the Z2 time-reversal-invariant topological insulator and quantum spin Hall effect, predicted by Kane and Mele and observed in HgTe/CdTe wells by Molenkamp, with about two decades of independent confirmation and a stable interpretation. The criterion became a routine first-principles computation, which shows its reach. The Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang omission is a real weakness, tolerable only with a citation narrowed to the quantum spin Hall effect. P002 (optical lattice clocks) has the cleaner two-name credit and a distinct magic-wavelength mechanism, so it ranks second, ahead of no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; methodological proximity to DMFT and first-principles theory is not relevant to P001 or P002
